text:
German gnats of delicate sips, dandruff of the tastiest wine measures: because fire has moths, you want must to have wine-moths.


Winged wicks, petty atoms, drunken specks, vinous birds, envious fluff of wines, bees of bacon's honey.


Nits of the vintage, I admit you to my throat, since the grandson of the vine, blessed liquor, is your rope.


Sail with the swallow toward my Adam's apple; by drinking you all I repay the wine you drank, which drowns you.

translation.title: He Drinks Fine Wine with Gnats Inside
